questions: What does 'modulo' refer to? Is it a specific modulus (e.g., 998244353, 10^9+7) or should it be taken modulo something else?
Should the sum of scores be computed modulo a specific modulus, and if so, what is that modulus?
Are the sequences S considered ordered tuples, so that different permutations of the same multiset of values count separately if they satisfy the conditions?
Is the sequence A indexed from 1 to N-1, and does the condition apply for each i in that range, ensuring S_i and S_{i+1} are consecutive?
Can the elements S_i be any positive integers, or are they bounded (e.g., by constraints from A_i)?
Is the gcd condition applied to the entire sequence S, meaning the greatest common divisor of all N elements must be exactly 1?
For the function f, when expressing x as P/Q with coprime positive integers, is the representation unique, and does it assume P and Q are positive?
Should the sum of scores be taken over all possible good sequences, and if there are infinitely many, how is the sum defined?
